question: Check count-only evidence coverage for daridorexant in pregnancy across PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, DailyMed, LactMed and MPRINT. Explain what each count does and does not establish.
criteria: Use count-only probes. LactMed is lactation-only and not applicable to pregnancy. Do not equate counts or zero matches with evidence quality or safety. Preserve unknown versus zero.
answer:
## Count-only coverage: daridorexant in pregnancy

| Source | Returned count/status | What the count establishes | What it does not establish |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **PubMed** | **3 matches** | Three records matched the returned daridorexant–pregnancy search query. [S4](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) | The matches are not verified human outcomes, distinct studies, or evidence-quality assessments. Abstracts and findings were not retrieved. The query also reported that daridorexant was not found as a MeSH term. |
| **ClinicalTrials.gov** | **4 registrations** | Four registry records matched `daridorexant AND (pregnancy)`. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/) | Registration matches do not establish posted results, enrollment, outcomes, or confirmed applicability to pregnancy. |
| **DailyMed** | **1 label** | One name-matched product label was returned. [S2](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/) | The count does not establish pregnancy-specific sections, current FDA approval, or independent evidence. |
| **LactMed** | **Not applicable** | LactMed is a lactation-only resource and was not counted as pregnancy evidence. | It does not provide a pregnancy count or establish the presence or absence of pregnancy evidence elsewhere. |
| **MPRINT Gold snapshot** | **0 rows; 0 distinct PMIDs** | No literal daridorexant-name matches were found in the selected MPRINT Gold snapshot tables. Snapshot date: **November 17, 2026**; revision `4bdee90dff3610816e86d0eed29b4c4d0fe77e89`. [S3](https://github.com/langli-lab/mprint-kp-data) | The count is limited to literal drug-name row matches in the selected snapshot tables; rows are not distinct studies. It does not establish that no relevant research exists elsewhere, and no MPRINT outcomes were retrieved. These linkage and interpretation limits are from this MCP lookup, not claims about the dataset authors. |

This was a **count-only coverage lookup**, not a retrieval of study findings, abstracts, registry results, or label narratives. The counts are not comparable across sources and do not establish evidence quality, clinical safety, or what any study found. Zero matches can reflect query, indexing, snapshot, or population limits; they are not evidence of safety or proof that evidence is absent elsewhere.

The lookup also reported that it did not identify a curated federal pregnancy counterpart to LactMed in its prototype source review; that finding is not proof that no such resource exists.
